method: Actual all-part PrusaSlicer2.9.4 slicing plus independent canonical mesh/STEP/3MF, orientation, analytical layer/bridge/wall, toolpath/profile/warning and complete package gates.
environment: Windows; Python3.11.3; Node25.9.0; pinned CadQuery2.8.0/OCP7.9.3.1.1/VTK9.6.2/numpy2.4.6/shapely2.1.2; official Windows PrusaSlicer2.9.4; actual Codex in-app Chromium browser.
limitations: No physical print or fit test. Owner printer is unknown; generic220x220x250 PETG/.4nozzle/.2layer profile.
Digital gates do not qualify adhesive, wood condition, creep/fatigue, transport loads, actual servo torque, cables/FPC, hand dexterity or electrical operation.
Cam/material motion is sampled every10degrees; finite-wire checks use0/80/160degrees. Continuous conservative envelopes qualify new tray joints/beams only.
Control removal and USB manual dressing are sampled digital sweeps. Actual soldered leads, terminal bends and retention require physical acceptance.
Linux PrusaSlicer2.9.6 CI and the Git/PR review endpoint remain pending when these local receipts are created.
observation: 51types/71prints regenerated and actually sliced with zero support deposition and no raft. Every solid is valid; actual mesh connectivity, manifoldness, oriented facets, degeneracy, self-intersections, dimensions/volume and STEP/3MF roundtrip passed. All orientations pass the conservative45degree/.4mm process-wall/12mm two-ended bridge checks with.03mm numerical tolerance. Only microphone and two left cassette frames use3mm brim. Forty short pilot closures need the documented smoothØ3.4hand awl. Floating/loose/weak/unknown warnings are fatal; legitimate anchored bridge warnings require geometric gap proof.
supersedesReason: The final integrated89-source artifact changed. Actual gates were repeated against its exact digest; earlier evidence and truthful failures remain immutable.
resolution: Through-bores/vents and accessible nut slots replace enclosed cavities. Short-axis bridges are explicit. The weak rear prong was removed, its key relocated to supported material and C1 duct roof opened. Every final export was resliced.

tool.name: PrusaSlicer

 --delete-after-load ABCD
                     Delete files after loading.
 --ignore-nonexistent-config
                     Do not fail if a file supplied to --load does not exist.
 --loglevel N        Sets logging sensitivity. 0:fatal, 1:error, 2:warning, 3:info, 4:debug, 5:trace
                     For example. loglevel=2 logs fatal, error and warning level messages.
 --opengl-aa         Automatically select the highest number of samples for OpenGL antialiasing.
 --opengl-compatibility
                     Enable OpenGL compatibility profile
 --opengl-debug      Activate OpenGL debug output on graphic cards which support it (OpenGL 4.3 or
                     higher)
 --opengl-version ABCD
                     Select a specific version of OpenGL
 --output ABCD, -o ABCD
                     The file where the output will be written (if not specified, it will be based on
                     the input file).
 --single-instance   If enabled, the command line arguments are sent to an existing instance of GUI
                     PrusaSlicer, or an existing PrusaSlicer window is activated. Overrides the
                     "single_instance" configuration value from application preferences.
 --sw-renderer       Render with a software renderer. The bundled MESA software renderer is loaded
                     instead of the default OpenGL driver.
 --threads N         Sets the maximum number of threads the slicing process will use. If not defined,
                     it will be decided automatically.

Print options are processed in the following order:
	1) Config keys from the command line, for example --fill-pattern=stars
	   (highest priority, overwrites everything below)
	2) Config files loaded with --load
	3) Config values loaded from 3mf files

Run --help-fff / --help-sla to see the full listing of print options.
